_provenance: cfa (Contacts / Fund Accounts) MongoDB schema, RECONSTRUCTED from Go code only — cfa has no
$jsonSchema validators active on ANY collection in production (two drafts exist commented-out,
see contacts._provenance_note below; all others pass `nil` as the validator arg). This file is
therefore a code-derived approximation of document shape, not a transcription of an enforced
schema. NO DATA ROWS. Source: cfa/internal/contacts/model.go, cfa/internal/fund_accounts/model.go,
IMPORTANT: cfa's read/write path round-trips every document through encoding/json (not bson
struct tags) — see pkg/storage/mongodb/transform.go:79-247. Field names below are the JSON field
names actually persisted, which is what matters for a twin; the `bson:` tags in Go source can
diverge and are NOT what ends up on disk.
UNIQUENESS: contacts.id, fund_accounts.id, hash_lookup.hash have NO unique index anywhere in the
duplicates were found and unique indexes were never added). Do not add unique indexes to a twin
seeking to reproduce production; do add them only if intentionally testing a stricter posture.

type.enum_enforced: NOT enforced as a blanket field constraint in ContactModel.Validate() — only gated downstream for one internal-app-permission call path (internal/fund_accounts/validate.go:39-64)

hash.required: field-optional but always set in practice — SHA3-256 dedup hash

contacts._provenance_note: A unique index on {id:1} exists only as commented-out code (1715709457_create_contacts_collection.go:73-76) — never actually created.

account_type.enum_gap: account_type='mobile' is REJECTED by FundAccountModel.ValidateWithConfig (model.go:164-192) — no case for it, falls to default error — even though MobileDetails/proto fully model it. Confirmed gap, not speculative.

wallet.present_iff: account_type=wallet_account (NOT 'wallet' despite a stale code comment at model.go:50)
wallet.provider_enum_gap: ValidateWallet() (validate.go:225-227) accepts ONLY amazonpay; paytm/phonepe/gpay are declared constants but rejected at create time.

card.note: ValidateCard() is a hard no-op (validate.go:277-279) — no field-level enforcement at the Mongo-model layer for card sub-documents

mobile.present_iff: account_type=mobile (but see enum_gap above — cannot be created via ValidateWithConfig)

hash.note: app always sets via GenerateHash() SHA3-256

hash_lookup._provenance_note: NO indexes created at all for this collection (1715709458_create_hash_lookup_collection.go:27-63) — not even on `hash`, despite existing to look records up by hash. UNKNOWN whether one was added out-of-band; ask the cfa/DocumentDB owner for db.hash_lookup.getIndexes().

tokenized_iin._provenance_note: No SetDefaults/Validate logic (both no-ops, model.go:40-42,50-52) and no index-creation code found anywhere in the repo, despite being queried by token_iin+active. UNKNOWN — ask for db.tokenized_iin.getIndexes().

iins.source: internal/fund_accounts/card/model.go:135-149 (collection name is a bare string literal, no named constant)
iins._provenance_note: Same as tokenized_iin — no defaults/validation, no known indexes. UNKNOWN.

migrations.source: cmd/migration/main.go:289 (internal tracking collection, not domain data)

_engine_note: Production runs AWS DocumentDB (TLS + SCRAM-SHA-1), not vanilla MongoDB (pkg/storage/mongodb/mongo.go:63-82). A local twin using real MongoDB is not identical at the engine-behavior level (DocumentDB has known gaps in $jsonSchema, some aggregation operators, TTL index support depending on engine version). Exact DocumentDB engine version is UNKNOWN from this repo (ops/Terraform-owned).
